description: Start crawling a section of one site: from url, follow links in the start path's subtree on its host and www twin, up to maxPages pages and maxDepth links deep. Returns { taskId } at once (with maxPages when the default of 100 applied); wait_crawl waits for it, then get_crawl_pages reads the pages. How long the server keeps them is not stated. Each page takes scrape's page options (formats, onlyMainContent, includeTags, waitFor, timeout, verify and the rest; their descriptions are on scrape). Similar URLs fold into one page, and every collapsed or refused link is counted in get_crawl's discovery.

access.description: standard (default) or enhanced: also the paid providers the operator approved.

allowExternalLinks.description: Follow links to any host, each with its own robots.txt; maxDepth and maxPages bound the walk. Default false. Not with allowlistedDomains.

allowSubdomains.description: Follow links to every host under the start URL's apex. Default false.

crawlEntireDomain.description: Follow links anywhere on the start host, not only in the start path's subtree. Default false.

deduplicateSimilarURLs.description: Treat /a and /a/, www and apex, http and https as one page. Default true.

excludePaths.description: Pathname regexes that skip a discovered link; they win over includePaths.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and arguments return the first taskId. Kept 24 hours.

ignoreQueryParameters.description: Treat URLs that differ only in their query as one page. Default false.

ignoreRobotsTxt.description: Also fetch what robots.txt disallows (recorded, with a warning). Default false. Local server only.

includePaths.description: Pathname regexes a discovered link must match; the start URL is always fetched.

integration.description: Your workflow label (printable, no spaces); recorded, not sent to sites.

maxConcurrency.description: Pages fetched at once, at most (only lowers the worker count).

maxDepth.description: Links followed from the start URL at most. Omitted or null: no limit.

maxPages.description: Pages fetched at most. Omitted: 100. null: the server's default (none on a local server; hosted servers cap it).

mode.description: standard (default) or research; for signed-in pages send a batch in mode authed.

regexOnFullURL.description: Match includePaths and excludePaths against each link's canonical URL instead of its pathname. Default false.

sitemap.description: include (default): also queue the site's sitemap URLs. skip: no sitemap. only: the start URL and the sitemap entries.

webhook.description: Where the job posts events, retried: a URL or { url, headers?, metadata?, events?, secretEnv? } (a W2L_WEBHOOK_SECRET_* variable signing them).

name: crawl
title: Start a crawl
